title: Weight-Space Programming
subtitle: LLMs that read and write neural network weights

chapters.title: Read the picture in the weights
chapters.blurb: A language model names each game from raw weights alone, and finds the shape a diffusion model draws, with no forward passes.

chapters.title: Read where the heads look
chapters.blurb: Copying heads are found in the middle-layer weights alone. Attention patterns then expose a sycophant that the weights alone could not.

chapters.title: A side path that switches off
chapters.blurb: One edit to 3.5 percent of a stalled car's policy weights adds a side path that backs the car up, then switches off.

chapters.title: Write a network from zero
chapters.blurb: With no training, Astra writes a Breakout network and a nine by nine Go network, and both are scored against PPO baselines.

chapters.title: Subtract the loop
chapters.blurb: Qwen's looping traces to one direction in two layers. Subtracting it touches 0.016 percent of the weights and lifts math scores.
